outcome: neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: The study retrospectively analyzed medical records of 616 pregnant women, comprising 309 adolescents and 307 adults.
finding: Adolescent pregnant women exhibited higher rates of fetal distress, oligohydramnios, preterm birth, premature rupture of membranes, and intrauterine growth restriction, as well as lower birth weights, compared to adult pregnant women.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome, found to be lower in the adolescent group.
